item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Sep 16
item.description:
90 development commits

Map & UI

  • New country selection UI with continent tabs, fixed row width, region selection bugs, and auto‑detect now replaces mismatched selections and adds missing country centers.

Player Controls

  • Eliminated head and forearm jitter while aiming and turning, and remote players now rotate fully instead of taking the shortest turn.

Livestock & Critters

  • Multiplayer animal interaction fixed: only the animal following the speaking player appears in the list, preventing duplicate rolls and multiple leaders.
  • Critters now avoid water when roaming or fleeing, and will startle and run away when players get too close, without startling each other.
  • Livestock AI simplified by removing idle sensing states and reducing sight range.
  • Bears immediately flee without a brief chase, correcting their flee behavior.
  • Cows now avoid clipping with each other and players, and cannot eat from a trough through other cows.

Fortifications & Explosives

  • Non‑default sandbag variants are no longer craftable; only the default sandbag can be crafted.
  • Sandbag upgrade system overhauled: server‑side placement checks, fixed cooldowns, upgrades retain current health fraction, clipping prevented, and additional reliability checks added.
  • C4 prediction improved with better client settings, hide/show controls, and correct rotation blending over its full distance.

Loot & Economy

  • Loot tables adjusted for Trainyard, water‑treatment, and sewer‑branch rooms.
  • Experimental guns added to the sell table and an animal auction mechanic introduced, offering three random items with up to two rejections before the vendor becomes unavailable for 15 minutes.

Server & Admin

  • ServerSetGod command allows the server to set and broadcast a player’s god mode status.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Sep 15
item.description:
96 development commits

Food & Drink

  • Creamy and milky tea variants adjust healing effectiveness and duration (e.g., creamy healing tea 97 HP/20 s, milky healing tea 112 HP/45 s).
  • Milk can be processed after 4 hours in a refrigerated container to produce skimmed milk (½ calories, 80 % hydration, ½ health) and cream (½ calories, 20 % hydration, +50 % health).

World & Structures

  • Apples now have a 10 % chance to survive if the tree is harvested before fruit is picked, and fruit no longer falls when a tree is hit.
  • Apartment complexes are flagged as safe zones and placement restrictions near them now correctly warn when too close.

Animals & AI

  • Critters remain active throughout the night, and rabbits no longer react to nearby items, reducing server load.
  • Turtle spawning issues have been resolved, ensuring turtles appear in the world as intended.
  • Sheep now correctly mark attackers as hostile, walk, attack players, and die as expected.

UI & Controls

  • UI improvements: background tile sprite restored, server browser filter works correctly, player count display remains stable when switching gamemodes, and market terminals show a "No Power" message when unpowered.
  • Alt + Mouse wheel now provides fine‑grained zoom control.
  • Store UI now falls back to the first completed image request if the HTTP image delay expires, reducing missing images.
  • Added a new bind command for gamepad defaults and fixed reset behavior when no keyboard/mouse is bound.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Added explosive setup to certain weapons, enabling explosive damage.
  • Fixed beef spoil item assignment, ensuring proper food spoilage.

Building & Placement

  • Fences no longer sink into terrain, can be placed on slopes and angled up to 20°, improving building precision.
  • Ladder hatches are now skinnable and feature open/close functionality for workshop use.

Equipment & Protection

  • Hazmat suits now include the missing component, restoring intended protection levels.
